definitions.explanation: A hand tool with a sharp beveled edge used for carving, cutting, or shaping wood, stone, or metal. Typically struck with a mallet to drive it into the material.

examples.japanese: のみ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{槌|つち}→槌：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彫|ほ}る→彫る：00114_horu⟧。
examples.english: I carve wood using a chisel and mallet.
The carpenter cut a groove with a chisel.
I sharpened the chisel blade on a whetstone.

notes:
KANJI WRITING:
・{鑿|のみ} (rarely used, complex kanji)
・Usually written in hiragana

TYPES OF CHISELS:
・⟦{追入|おいいれ}→追入：noentry⟧のみ (paring chisel - for fine work)
・⟦{叩|たた}き→叩く：02072_tataku⟧のみ (firmer chisel - struck with mallet)
・⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧のみ (gouge - curved blade)
・⟦{平|ひら}→ひら：28886_hira⟧のみ (flat chisel)

RELATED TOOLS:
・⟦{槌|つち}→槌：noentry⟧/⟦{木槌|きづち}→木槌：noentry⟧ (mallet)
・⟦かんな→かんな：06549_kanna⟧ (plane)
・⟦{砥石|といし}→砥石：06525_toishi⟧ (whetstone)
・⟦たがね→たがね：06547_tagane⟧ (cold chisel - for metal)

COLLOCATIONS:
・のみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to apply the chisel)
・のみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ (to shave with a chisel)
・のみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彫|ほ}る→彫る：00114_horu⟧ (to carve with a chisel)
・のみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (to sharpen a chisel)
